lines.text: The men who arrested Jesus led Him to the house of Caiaphas, and Peter followed at a distance.
Many false witnesses came forward, and finally two said Jesus claimed He could destroy the walls of Jerusalem and rebuild them in three days.
Jesus remained silent, then answered the high priest's oath, and the high priest tore his clothes and said He had blasphemed.
A servant girl said Peter was with Jesus the Galilean, and he denied it, then at the gateway swore an oath.
Bystanders said Peter's sword gave him away, he cursed and swore, a rooster crowed, and he wept bitterly.
